description: Open an INSTANT shift for assets with no on-chain DEX route — Tron (USDT-TRC20, TRX), BTC, cross-chain. Returns a deposit address: send the `from` asset there and the `to` asset settles to your address. Custodial AT THE VENUE during the swap (~minutes); blueDEX never holds funds. Use list_instant_assets for ids.

from.description: instant asset id to send, e.g. 'usdc-base'

refundAddress.description: optional: refund destination if the shift fails or expires

settleAddress.description: your receiving address for the `to` asset

to.description: instant asset id to receive, e.g. 'usdt-tron'

name: create_instant_shift
title: Create instant cross-chain shift
